facts.fact: The article states the BCEAO has applied Instruction no. 001-01-2024 since January 2024, a general framework obliging all fintechs offering payment services in the WAEMU zone to obtain a licence or cease activity.

Under BCEAO Instruction no. 001-01-2024 payment institutions that are not banks are licensed by scope of service, with minimum capital of CFA 10 million, 20 million or 100 million; the article says only 20 payment institutions held a licence across the eight member states by September 2025 (published 17 February 2026, no event date given for the licensing rule beyond January 2024).
